claims.content: Enable system admin to create unique, validated user accounts within user groups

goal.raw_text: Enable system admin to create unique, validated user accounts within user groups

claims.content: System Administrator
The actor must be the System Administrator
At least one User Group must exist in the system to select from
The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new individual user account.

trigger.raw_text: The System Administrator initiates the creation of a new individual user account.

claims.content: The System Administrator selects an existing Group Name from the User Group list.
The System Administrator enters a unique User Name.
The System Administrator enters a Password.
The System Administrator enters the Verify Password value.
The system validates that all mandatory fields (Group Name, User Name, Password, Verify Password) are provided.
The system checks that the Password and Verify Password values are equal.
The system verifies that no existing User Group or Individual User has the same name as the one being created.
If all validations pass, the system saves the new individual user account information under the selected user group.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If a User Group or Individual User with an existing name is attempted to be created, the system does not allow the creation.
If the Password and Verify Password values are not equal, the system does not save the user information.
If a User Group or Individual User with an existing name is attempted to be created, the system does not allow the creation.
A new individual user account is created and saved under the selected user group.
The newly created user account contains mandatory fields: Group Name (selected from User Group), User Name, Password, and Verify Password.
The system ensures that no duplicate User Group or Individual User names exist after creation.
